title: Unit 6: Making a Difference: Future Forms - Will, Going to, Present Continuous
objective: Mampu menggunakan will (not), may (not), dan might (not) untuk prediksi; menggunakan first conditional dan unless dalam kalimat kondisional pertama; serta memahami kosakata lingkungan dan energi

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara menyatakan prediksi masa depan dengan will, won't, may, may not, might, dan might not. Will digunakan untuk kepastian di masa depan, sedangkan may dan might untuk kemungkinan. Selain itu, kamu akan belajar first conditional (if + present simple, will/won't + verb) untuk membicarakan konsekuensi aksi yang mungkin terjadi, dan penggunaan unless yang berarti 'only if / if not'.
rules: Will / Won't untuk kepastian masa depan: 'In a few years' time, there won't be any tigers left.'
May (not) / Might (not) untuk kemungkinan: 'Some animals may be gone forever very soon.'
First Conditional (If + present simple, will/won't + main verb): 'If we lose the forests, we will lose millions of species.'
Unless dalam first conditional berarti 'only if / if not': 'Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment will suffer even more.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampurkan Will dan Might
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung kapan memakai will dan kapan memakai might/may. Will digunakan saat kamu yakin sesuatu akan terjadi, sedangkan might/may untuk hal yang mungkin terjadi tapi belum pasti.
commonTrap.wrong: I will pick you up at 7, but I'm not sure yet.
commonTrap.correct: I might pick you up at 7, but I'm not sure yet.

dialogue.context: Dua orang teman berdiskusi tentang rencana liburan dan proyek film

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: He has offered me a role in his next film.
lines.translation: Dia menawarkan saya peran di film berikutnya.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: He's only going to meet Stephen Spielberg.
lines.translation: Dia hanya akan bertemu Stephen Spielberg.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'm going to California this summer.
lines.translation: Saya akan pergi ke California musim panas ini.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Oh, really? Only three hours. Why's that?
lines.translation: Oh, benarkah? Hanya tiga jam. Kenapa begitu?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How exciting! What are you going to talk about?
lines.translation: Menarik sekali! Apa yang akan kamu bicarakan?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Wow! That sounds exciting. How long are you going to stay there?
lines.translation: Wah! Kedengarannya menarik. Berapa lama kamu akan tinggal di sana?

speakingLab.context: Latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang lingkungan dan rencana masa depan

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today let's talk about the environment. What environmental problems do you think are the most serious in your area?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think air pollution from factories is a big problem in my town.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a serious issue. What do you think will happen if we don't do something about it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: If we don't stop the pollution, the air quality will get worse and people might get sick.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very good! Now tell me, what will you do this weekend to help the environment?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I might recycle plastic bottles and I won't waste water when I brush my teeth.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Those are great actions. Do you think your friends will join you?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I think they will. Unless they are too busy, they will probably help too.

quiz.question: Complete: In a few years' time, there _____ any tigers left.
options: won't be
might not be
will be
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'won't be' untuk menyatakan prediksi yang sangat mungkin atau kepastian negatif di masa depan.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: If we lose the forests, we will lose millions of species.
If we will lose the forests, we lose millions of species.
If we lose the forests, we lose millions of species.
quiz.answer: If we lose the forests, we will lose millions of species.
quiz.explanation: First conditional menggunakan pola: If + present simple, will/won't + verb.

quiz.question: Complete: She _____ feeling well at all. She might not have to stay at home.
options: is not
might not be
won't be
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama menyatakan fakta sekarang, jadi gunakan present simple 'is not'. 'Might not' untuk kemungkinan di masa depan.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses 'unless' correctly?
options: Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment will suffer.
Unless people will stop throwing plastic away, the environment suffers.
Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment suffer.
quiz.answer: Unless people stop throwing plastic away, the environment will suffer.
quiz.explanation: 'Unless' berarti 'if not' dan menggunakan pola first conditional: unless + present simple, will + verb.

quiz.question: Complete: The weather's a real problem. We _____ be able to go for a walk.
options: may not
will not
don't
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'may not' atau 'might not' untuk kemungkinan negatif yang tidak pasti.

quiz.question: Choose the correct response to express enthusiasm:
options: That sounds wonderful!
I don't think so.
I'm not sure about that.
quiz.explanation: Untuk mengekspresikan antusiasme atau kejutan positif, gunakan frasa seperti 'That sounds wonderful!', 'How exciting!', atau 'What a brilliant idea!'
